## Background

Copy #7935 at source head `750744dbcb205272acbb6e46f6ae79d913b21f6f` onto `main`.

## What changed

Switch code-freeze authentication from PAT to the GitHub App and pin the shared workflow to `61445a177938967f70c94094b98402e979452151`.

## Details

All three source commits retain cherry-pick provenance. The source synchronization merge is an empty signed commit, preserving newer target-main changes. Only `.github/workflows/release-freeze.yml` differs; its final blob matches the pinned source.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Dispatch --> Wrapper[Code-freeze wrapper]
  Wrapper --> Shared[Pinned shared workflow]
  App[GitHub App credentials] --> Shared
```

## Tested

- Native changed-file pre-commit completed; Python-only hooks skipped by their own filters.
- Diff whitespace, source-blob identity, signatures, and signoffs verified.
- ML/GPU tests excluded: product and dependency inputs unchanged.
- actionlint unavailable due denied asset access. Full required CI pending.

detail.title: cp: use GitHub App authentication for code freeze

files.patch:
@@ -32,10 +32,15 @@ on:
         description: Dry-run of code-freeze
         required: false
         default: true
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
 jobs:
   code-freeze:
-    uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_code_freeze.yml@bfdb5e35067fd8cd91ce21fca4eb1072ffd7ab8c # v1.4.2
+    uses: NVIDIA-NeMo/FW-CI-templates/.github/workflows/_code_freeze.yml@61445a177938967f70c94094b98402e979452151 # github app authentication
     with:
+      app-id: ${{ vars.BOT_ID }}
+      environment-name: main
       library-name: Megatron-Core
       python-package: megatron.core
       release-type: ${{ inputs.release-type }}
@@ -44,8 +49,7 @@ jobs:
       next-pre-release: ""
       next-dev: ""
       release-branch-prefix: core_
-      use-pat: true
     secrets:
       SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ inputs.dry-run && secrets.SLACK_CI_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK ||secrets.SLACK_MAIN_CHANNEL_WEBHOOK }}
       SLACK_WEBHOOK_ADMIN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_TEAM_GROUP_ID }}
-      PAT: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
+      BOT_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOT_KEY }}
